requirements_summary: Build JetBrains (IntelliJ/PyCharm) plugin that performs local repository symbol indexing + token streaming completions. Primary path: local quantized model (6B) pinned per workspace for instant keystroke suggestions. Secondary path: hosted model fallback for large refactors, code generation and multi-file reasoning. Must support: websocket streaming, prefix/KV caching persisted to disk, model-version pinning per project, Okta SSO, audit logging, and EU residency for EU teams. Latency targets: median completion 30-80ms, 95th <200ms for small contexts. Throughput target ~200 interactive QPS across dev teams during peak. Budget constrained; willing to evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity if cost predictable.
